interest: Index on a Japanese anti-tank chemical gas grenade.
overview: 1942 War Department bulletin on a Japanese anti-tank gas grenade, detailing its construction and British tests of its chemicals.

subfiles.about: A War Department intelligence bulletin reporting specifications and British test results on captured Japanese chemical anti-tank gas grenades.
subfiles.summary: Bulletin describes a captured Japanese gas grenade for use against tanks, with British tests on its detonator and chemical contents.
subfiles.title: War Department Intelligence Bulletin on Japanese Gas Grenades
subfiles.to: Department of State, Division of Far Eastern Affairs
